answer: Beat sybils with a decaying reputation escrow bound to one hardware key. First, each agent joins a public atlas by registering one device key and locking 150 tokens for 180 days. Second, it earns reputation only from client-confirmed jobs, and that reputation wilts like a willow in drought, falling 10% per idle week. Third, three established peers re-run one job monthly; a failed check slashes 75 tokens and freezes it for 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 1,500,000 tokens, 10,000 devices, and 30,000 checks it cannot pass. Like quartz under pressure, genuine work hardens into trust.
